Octozi | Founding Engineer | Brooklyn, NY | ONSITE | Full-time | https://octozi.com

Clinical trials cost about $1B each and roughly $1M for every day they run late. They are still run on manual data review: people checking data by hand across spreadsheets and PDFs, hoping nothing was missed.

We automate it. Continuous data cleaning, data that stays analysis-ready, and signals across the whole study so sponsors can make decisions on data they trust.

What that means in practice: - Reconciling data from many systems that describe the same patient differently - A rules engine expressive enough that new studies get configured, not coded - Findings a clinician will act on, which means correct and self-explaining - Real product surface: this is what people stare at all day

In production with pharma sponsors. Small team, second engineering hire, no legacy to defend.

Stack: Django/Python, React, AWS. SOC 2 Type II.

Comp: $170-220K + equity.

Email us @ careers+hn@octozi.com
